mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%) signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate sustained liquidity support.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5% for two consecutive months, it indicates labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of periods when UNRATE > 5.5% for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) from prior month indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as earnings expectations adjust downward.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 for interaction signal over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0% yoy), the Federal Reserve accelerates policy tightening, increasing equity discount rates and reducing valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0% yoy, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS > 150,000 thousand) signals labor market strength that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in >50% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 for two consecutive months, it indicates manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate output and profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of periods when INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous negative quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly housing starts decline (HOUST) indicate economic deceleration that triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of periods when both GDPC1 shows negative quarterly change and HOUST declines from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 for interaction signal over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In retail sales contraction regimes (RSAFS decline from prior month), consumer spending weakness reduces near-term corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market sentiment shifts downward.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in >50% of periods when RSAFS declines from prior month, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
